image.input_role: user-approved fish, transparent margins cropped/padded only

description: Preserve this EXACT approved creature: identical silhouette, anatomy, number of tails/fins/eyes, markings and species colors. Render it at the new native resolution with finer clean pixel clusters and more defined original-style highlights and shadows, NOT a nearest-neighbor enlargement. Face LEFT. Keep the whole creature centered, about 200 pixels wide, with transparent margins. No redesign, extra fins, eyes, tail, particles, glow halo or background.
